purpose: Signature detectors that identify a workspace previously bootstrapped by AlexMaster (Marketplace ID fabioc-aloha.alex-cognitive-architecture, v8.x or v9.x). Used by extension.js migration logic to decide whether to offer the AlexMaster -> ACT Edition migration modal.
source: Captured 2026-05-24 from C:\Development\AlexMaster local repo (v9.0.1 HEAD; Marketplace published v8.4.0). v8.4.0 was never tagged locally; structural signatures below are stable across the v8.x-v9.x range that the 78 installed seats may carry.
detectionRule: Workspace is considered AlexMaster-bootstrapped if: (1) NO `antiSignals` match (anti-signals are a hard kill-switch — they identify constellation-author repos that must never be migrated), AND (2) ANY of `strongSignals` matches OR 2+ `weakSignals` match.

strongSignals.rationale: AlexMaster-only file; ACT Edition ships brain version inside copilot-instructions.md frontmatter, not as a separate JSON.
AlexMaster-only file; not part of ACT Edition's brain layout.
AlexMaster hooks system; ACT Edition does not use hooks.json.
AlexMaster identity statements that ACT Edition's copilot-instructions.md never contains.

matchAny: top of the chain for the ACT-Edition constellation
antiSignals.rationale: Workspace IS the Supervisor (Alex_ACT_Supervisor) — top of the constellation, not an AlexMaster heir. Never offer migration.
Workspace is the framework-author repo (contains the ACT Manifesto source). Never offer migration.
Workspace IS the Alex_ACT_Extension source repo (contains the signature manifest itself). Never offer self-migration.

weakSignals.rationale: AlexMaster ships this; ACT Edition's own brain template also ships it, so this is a weak signal (not exclusive). Multiple shared brains include it.
AlexMaster ships episodic/ for post-mortems and chronicle entries; ACT Edition does not.
AlexMaster ships quality/ for dream reports and brain QA outputs; ACT Edition does not by default.
AlexMaster ships ABOUT.md at brain root; ACT Edition does not.

Prior AlexMaster upgrade backup dirs from older `/upgrade` cycles. Strong correlate but not exclusive (the ACT Edition migration itself produces .github-backup-<ISO>/, so this signal must be ignored AFTER migration runs once).

doNotPreserve.reason: Replaced by ACT Edition's own brain manifest.
ACT Edition has no hooks system.
ACT Edition has no hooks system.

preserveAsLocal.reason: User-authored post-mortems and chronicle entries. Not replaced by ACT Edition; preserved as user content.
User-authored quality reports and dream outputs. Preserved as user content.
Project-specific north-star statement; preserved as user content.
Project-specific API registry; preserved as user content.
Project-specific identity statement; preserved as user content.

alwaysBackup.contents: Verbatim snapshot of every file under .github/ at the moment migration starts, regardless of preservation rules. Never auto-deleted. User-managed via `Alex ACT: Clean Migration Backup` command.

wouldReviseIf: False positive (ACT Edition workspace mis-detected as AlexMaster) or false negative (AlexMaster workspace not detected) reported in any of the first 78 installed seats during the 90-day post-migration window.
